justification: Polish pass on the flag-gated (default OFF) overlay engine and UI: narrative sentence templates, grouped flow, footnoted citations, deterministic plan remaps, and manifest formatting. No DB access; overlay remains additive-only and dark in production; silent wrong output matters (standard), nothing mutates stored data (not critical).

pre_impl.existing_data: Renders the same manifest entries as #742; parses back ONLY our own k=v record format authored in brief_manifest._summarise_record — deterministic round-trip, no model output parsing.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Records missing expected keys (dev_type, control_type, comparable_count) fall back to the generic sentence rather than raising; unknown sources deslug via fallback.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Call-time rendering only, behind the same dual flags; older flat-lines responses still render via the UI compatibility branch.

functions.name: normalize_plan
functions.input: a schema-valid CompositionPlan plus its manifest before validation
functions.output: plan with deterministic template remaps applied and logged
functions.if_none: computed-source fields under fact templates become T_CAPACITY_RESULT and X ids under any fact template become T_FINDING — no model retry needed

functions.name: render_plan
functions.input: validated plan, manifest, optional deterministic caution note
functions.output: RenderedOverlay with grouped narrative, flat lines, and footnotes
functions.if_none: fact plans get headline empty string so the first sentence is never duplicated in header and body; standalone headlines render their authored text

functions.name: assign_footnotes
functions.input: rendered lines plus the manifest they cite
functions.output: numbered footnotes deduped per unique source, date and confidence
functions.if_none: lines citing X findings (no source) simply carry no footnote marker

functions.name: assemble_groups
functions.output: groups in fixed narrative order with authored sub-headers
functions.if_none: unknown template ids bucket into the context group rather than vanishing

functions.name: _eligibility_sentence
functions.input: one flattened SEPP standard row in our own k=v record format
functions.output: an authored sentence naming the form, lot-standard outcome, and form caps
functions.if_none: a row without dev_type falls back to the generic labelled value line

functions.name: _fmt_leaf_value
functions.input: manifest path plus a scalar value at emit time
functions.output: deterministic currency formatting for money leaves, else None
functions.if_none: non-money or sub-$100 values return None and render through the generic path with digits untouched

values.value: unit sibling (<field>_units) during the manifest walk
values.if_missing: no unit suffix appended; value renders exactly as before
authoritative/extracted render clean with footnote-only provenance; estimated and stale ALWAYS carry the inline qualifier so footnotes cannot launder confidence

break_it.scenario: First sentence duplicated as headline and body line (observed on the live preview overlay)
break_it.what_happens: Reader sees the identical zoning sentence twice at the top of the card
break_it.how: services/brief_narration.py render_plan — fact plans set headline to empty; only standalone decline/clarify templates render a headline

break_it.scenario: Capacity-engine outputs dressed as Planning control by the model (observed live)
break_it.what_happens: A computed setback reads as THE statutory control — a liability-relevant mislabel
break_it.how: normalize_plan remaps fact templates citing computed sources to T_CAPACITY_RESULT deterministically, no retry

break_it.scenario: A verified finding cited under a fact template renders its raw severity=… payload (observed live)
break_it.what_happens: Internal record syntax shown to the reader with doubled punctuation
break_it.how: normalize_plan routes any X id to T_FINDING which strips the severity prefix into tone

break_it.scenario: The secondary-dwelling standard row truncated mid-key at 200 chars (observed live: max_tot…)
break_it.what_happens: The single most decision-relevant row for a granny-flat reader loses its trailing standards
break_it.how: services/brief_manifest.py MAX_FLATTENED_RECORD_CHARS=420 for flattened decision-critical rows

break_it.scenario: Identical provenance repeated inline four times per sentence drowns the facts
break_it.what_happens: Unreadable output and the estimated-confidence qualifier gets lost in the noise
break_it.how: assign_footnotes dedupes per (source, date, confidence) while _confidence_qualifier keeps estimated/stale INLINE — footnotes cannot launder confidence

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — refresh the preview branch and re-check the overlay reads as grouped prose with footnote chips
